title: Life is not fair
author: HB S
content:
জীবন সবার জন্য সমান হয় না, কেও সব কিছু না চাইতেই পেয়ে যাই আর কেও সারাজীবন চেষ্টা ও কঠিন পরিশ্রম করে ও সেটা পায় না।

Life is not equal for everyone - some get everything without even asking for it, while others never get it even after a lifetime of trying and hard work.

That's reality. We can't change the game, but we can change how we play it.

title: Humans are curious creatures
author: HB S
excerpt: They want to understand and discover the world around them
content: Humans are curious creatures. They want to understand and discover the world around them.
